policies.name: reads-within-hourly-quota
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { context.reads_this_hour < 100 };

policies.name: hard-ceiling-on-reads
policies.code: forbid(principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { context.reads_this_hour >= 100 };

policies.name: writes-within-daily-quota
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"write", resource) when { context.writes_today < 20 };

tests.name: first read of the hour allows
99 reads so far still allows the 100th
